title: strict frontmatter validation dropping 30 of 33 skills
rationale: omp 17.3.5 routed any package declaring an agent-plugins.org $schema to its strict provider, which rejected any SKILL.md carrying a frontmatter key outside the Agent Skills set. Claude Code needs argument-hint and disable-model-invocation in the same file, so 30 of 33 skills disappeared and the maintainers had to drop $schema from the root manifest. Whether those keys are fatal is genuinely open, so this fixture records the answer rather than grading it. What is not open: declaring $schema must not cost a package skills that are otherwise valid.
quote: If a discovered skill does not conform to the Agent Skills specification, the client MUST skip that skill and continue loading other skills and component types.
